**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 of the MSA satisfies the LICENSE rule at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — 13.1 grants the subscription right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users; 13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates and permits contractors to support the material.
- **Not revocable at will** — 13.3 prohibits revocation or suspension except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. No "revocable" language appears in the grant.
- **Perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licence** — 13.2 is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, with modification and derivative-work rights; 14.3 confirms it covers Vendor Technology required to use a Deliverable, and 10.1 preserves paid-up licences after termination.
- **Successor transfer** — 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in an assignment permitted by Section 24, and 24.1 allows Customer to assign to an M&A successor without Vendor consent (exceeding the fallback).
- **Use restrictions** — 13.4 is narrow and carves out authorized security testing and use of Customer Data/output, so it does not undercut permitted use.
